data.name: 8hr Private Boat Tour
data.headline: 8 hours • Private charter • All ages
data.description: # Enjoy the beauty of Marco Island and the Ten Thousand Islands exactly your way!
data.itinerary:
The boat is all yours with your own captain. Design your own tour from the many things we do.
- Marco Island sightseeing
- 10,000 Islands
- Beach hopping
- Waterfront bars and restaurants
- History
- Eco-tour
- Dolphins
- Shelling
- Sunset
data.what_is_included:
Free parking
Cooler with ice
Shelling bags
data.what_is_not_included:
Bathroom on board
Gratutity
Food or drinks
data.cancellation_notes:
- Full refund if canceled 48+ hours before the tour.
- Cancellation insurance is available for any tour or ticket.
- No refunds for cancellations within 48 hours or late arrivals.
- Partial refund if the tour ends early for weather or safety reasons.
- Rescheduled tours can be subject to a rescheduling fee of $25 per ticket or $100 per private tour.
- Any canceled tours can be subject to a fee of $25 per ticket or $100 per private tour.
